Q1-FY26.quote: See as an endeavour for our company, we always seek to maintain a combined ratio close to 100% is what I've always mentioned over time. And that's what it remains, and that is what our endeavour shall always be.
Q1-FY26.targetText: Combined ratio targeted close to 100% on an ongoing basis

Q1-FY26.quote: While higher than 100%, we believe that the combined ratio for BAGIC will still be amongst the lowest in the multiline market with ROE reasonably above 20%.
Q1-FY26.targetText: BAGIC ROE to remain reasonably above 20%

Q1-FY26.quote: I think we're going to be one of the highest deltas in the industry this year. And I think we should expect that to directionally remain positive as we go forward in our growth journey.
Q1-FY26.targetText: VNB margin delta to remain directionally positive going forward

Q1-FY26.quote: The H2 growth, yes, will be significantly comfortable is what I can say... As far as H2 is concerned, I expect our growth to be in full bloom.
Q1-FY26.targetText: BALIC NBP growth to recover strongly in H2 FY26

Q1-FY26.quote: The company expects to disburse over 50 million new loans in the full financial year FY '26. BFL added about 4.69 million customers to its franchise during the quarter. The company expects to add about 14 million to 16 million new customers to its franchise in the full year FY '26.
Q1-FY26.targetText: BFL to disburse 50M+ new loans and add 14-16M customers in FY26

Q2-FY26.quote: It's just a quarterly blip. This will come down by the year-end is what we believe. With all the actions we are taking, we will come down to normal levels for full year is what I believe.
Q2-FY26.targetText: Motor OD loss ratio normalises to historical levels by FY26 year-end

Q2-FY26.quote: even if we assume a capital requirement of 200% for solvency (against the actual 150%), and Raman, please correct me if I'm wrong, the ROE for Bajaj General (BAGIC) is currently over 20%... we are delivering an ROE of around 24%.
Q2-FY26.targetText: ROE reasonably above 20% excluding surplus capital

Q2-FY26.quote: had that not been there, I think our confidence level in terms of margins that we have been saying would have definitely happened and we could have seen a margin expansion in the range of 4% to 6%
Q2-FY26.targetText: 4%–6% margin expansion for FY26 absent GST noise
Q2-FY26.conditional: Absent GST ITC disruption impact over next 2 quarters

Q2-FY26.quote: The studied strategy that we had on a flattish 4 quarters is over, and that ended September,25. And here on, you should see a trajectory on growth.
Q2-FY26.targetText: Growth to resume from Q3-FY26 onwards after 4 quarters of flat top-line

Q3-FY26.quote: For the combined ratio, we always maintain that we would be close to 100% and that is our ambition. And that is what we have been doing for so many years while maintaining or growing our market share.
Q3-FY26.targetText: close to 100% on an ongoing basis

Q3-FY26.quote: We believe that this combined ratio for Bajaj General will be among the lowest in the multi-line market, with the ROE reasonably above 22%, excluding the surplus capital at 200% solvency.
I don't think this kind of an increase is going to continue in the future. But yes, the trajectory will be positive. the margin expansion and VNB growth will definitely taper down from here on.
Q3-FY26.targetText: margin expansion to continue but taper from recent pace

Q3-FY26.quote: the margin expansion and VNB growth will definitely taper down from here on. I think that is the correct way to look at it. Having said that, our strategy of 2.0 is still under execution. GST just moved us back by about two to three quarters.
Q3-FY26.targetText: VNB growth to taper from ~50% average; strategy back on track in 2-3 quarters

Q4-FY25.quote: We expect VNB margin trajectory to be far steeper and hence a high growth in VNB margin versus what you would see in the revenue side.
Q4-FY25.targetText: VNB margin trajectory steeper, high growth vs revenue growth in FY26

Q4-FY25.quote: The growth we expect, which has been muted for particularly agency, shall remain slightly muted even in Q1. But having said that...H2 onwards you'll see growth for top line also starting to come up significantly.
Q4-FY25.targetText: Agency/top-line growth muted in Q1-FY26; significant recovery from H2-FY26

Q4-FY25.quote: BAGIC continues to deliver superior ROE on an annualized basis at about 16% versus 15.2% last year. And if we exclude the impact of surplus capital, which is taking solvency at 200%, the ROE is supposed to be even healthier at upwards of 22% for BAGIC.
Q4-FY25.targetText: ROE above 22% excluding surplus capital (solvency at 200%)
